## Description

Results arrive as uploaded PDFs/images (lab email/WhatsApp from patient) or manual entry of structured values. Matching suggests patients by name, DOB, MRN and open orders; low-confidence matches ("name matches, DOB differs") require a human to choose a candidate or reject. Confirmed results become INBOX_ITEMs linked to the order (state Result received).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A result with low-confidence match cannot enter any patient chart until a user confirms (UI + API).
- [ ] **AC2.** Candidates show MRN, DOB and open orders; the confirmation records actor and time.
- [ ] **AC3.** Matching a result to an open order moves the order's loop state to Result received.
- [ ] **AC4.** Unmatched documents stay in an "Unmatched" queue with count.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
